verdict.rationale: Mem0's self-hosted bundle offers per-user API keys with a request audit log, and entity-scoped memory lets you separate data by user/agent/app/session, which points toward scoping — but there's no documented mechanism for issuing least-privilege/permission-limited credentials (e.g., read-only vs write-only keys, expiring/revocable agent-specific tokens) for an individual agent identity. missing for 10: explicit least-privilege API key scopes/permissions, agent-specific credential issuance workflow, key revocation/expiry controls, independent confirmation this works as documented.
